[SWS_DM_01202] Get ClientAuthentication Instance
⌈
If the application
calls any of the overloaded methods ara::diag::ExternalAuthentication:-
:Get of the class ara::diag::ExternalAuthentication, the Diagnostic Man-
ager shall return an instance of the ara::diag::ClientAuthentication class
that is handling the Authentication State of the passed metaInfo or Diagnostic Client
Address.
⌋
